excerpt: Founded in 1984 ... on February 13, 1987, the construction of the main component, the CEBAF accelerator began. ... On 2 May 2018 the CEBAF 12 GeV Upgrade Dedication Ceremony took place. Located in Newport News, Virginia at coordinates 37 05'41''N 76 28'54''W. Since June 1, 2026 the facility has been operated by SURATech, LLC.
